items.summary: The shared opt-out rule read ordinary sentences as permanent exits: `/stop$/` caught `Please don't stop.`, `When will these problems stop?` and `Where is the bus stop`, and the Chinese branch caught `我希望不要再发生这种事。`; the ingestion path then wrote stage=OPTED_OUT, opted the contact target out and paused the conversation
verified_manually: the predicate was executed offline over 51 documented English and Chinese cases with 0 mismatches before and after the change
unverified: how many real customers were already written as OPTED_OUT by the old rule: the production database was not queried in this round
no real Facebook or Messenger message was ingested to confirm the corrected rule end to end

items.summary: A guardian that died before sending `ready` left a journal entry with no closure proof, so the Agent refused every later command and restarting did not clear it; the parent now records its own startup-failure record, which is deliberately distinct from a closure because no context was ever opened
verified_manually: typecheck passes with the recovery branch in place
the narrow reader refuses the new record: readClosure throws GUARDIAN_STARTUP_FAILED instead of returning it as a closed context
the fault-injection switch was unit-checked against 14 path and environment shapes before its test was withdrawn
items.remaining_work: The process-level regression for this path does not exist yet. The fault-injection switch validates <KFF_ROOT>/.kff/agent-process-tests/ with path.relative, and in the current harness the runtime resolves there correctly, yet the switch never activates: two file-writing probes placed at the guard entry and before its return wrote nothing, also after the tsx compile cache was cleared, which shows the Agent never reaches that code in this harness. The reworked harness, its four assertions and the probes were withdrawn rather than committed as a failing or skipped test.
unverified: the startup-failure recovery was never exercised by a real process crash in this round
no test asserts that a production runtime cannot arm the switch, only manual inspection of the guard

items.summary: Reading accepted a composer label after normalising whitespace while replying re-derived one exact ARIA string, so a conversation read as `发消息给 Alice` was reported as DRAFT_PRESENT when the reply tried to find its input box
verified_manually: the real Chromium fixture confirms the previous exact selector finds 0 elements for a spaced label while the shared rule finds 1
unverified: no real AdsPower profile or real Facebook thread was driven; the reply path itself still requires CONTROLLED_PILOT, human actor and live enablement

items.summary: The application-side destination filter refused only continuous digit runs and explicit schemes, so `+44 7700 900123`, `+1 (202) 555-0123`, `www.example.com`, `example.com/pay` and `sales@example.com` all passed into a customer reply
verified_manually: 9 destination samples were executed offline: 4 policy violations passed before the change and 0 after, with the currency and ordinary-text cases unchanged
unverified: no model was called to show whether a real provider would ever produce those strings
the filter is a heuristic: an unusual spelling may still pass and a legitimate dotted abbreviation may still be refused into human review

items.summary: Cancelling a run whose action was still QUEUED set action=CANCELED, job=DONE and run/task=CANCELED but never projected the linked record, so a WhatsApp invitation stayed QUEUED while reception returned it beside a cancelled action
verified_manually: reproduced on the isolated PostgreSQL database: with the projection disabled the referral still read QUEUED after the cancel, and the regression test failed with exactly that value
with the projection enabled the same test passes and both the referral and the action read CANCELED
unverified: no production database was read, so how many referrals are already stranded in QUEUED is unknown
the concurrent cancel-versus-dispatch race was not exercised
